metadata.description: Mods that make a long Claude Code session easier to read.

plugins.name: quiet-tools
plugins.description: Draws successful tool calls as one dim line in the terminal and hides their output, keeping its key facts (git commit, background, exit code meaning); a call a hook refused is one red line; failed calls stay in full; ctrl+o shows everything; /quiet-tools toggles it.

plugins.name: turn-nav
plugins.description: Lists your prompts in a pane and jumps the transcript to a selected prompt.

plugins.name: hook-notices
plugins.description: Fold this session's hook messages into one line above the prompt; open them in a scrollable pane.

plugins.name: prompt-band
plugins.description: Draw hook-notices' and turn-nav's lines above the prompt as one row.
